visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a black Kobe Bryant t-shirt, athletic shorts, and a backwards cap stands in a modern living room. Beside him is a young girl with long dark hair wearing a white graphic t-shirt and beige shorts. They are positioned in front of a white marble wall displaying a Silver and a Gold YouTube Creator Award. The man holds a thin wooden stick and taps the Silver award. (2) The man shifts his focus and taps the Gold Creator Award with the stick. The girl looks up at him with a neutral expression. The room is brightly lit with even studio-style lighting. A small poster with text and a photo is visible on the wall to the left of the awards. (3) The man points the stick toward the girl while speaking to her. A social media profile overlay appears on the screen, showing an account named @evadora with subscriber counts. The girl stands still, looking slightly hesitant. (4) A woman with long dark hair wearing a white short-sleeved top and skirt walks into the frame from the right. She crosses her arms and looks directly at the man. Another social media overlay for 'walkerdad1228' appears. The man's facial expression shifts from authoritative to shocked and speechless as the woman walks away. The video ends with a close-up on the man's frozen, wide-eyed face.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A rhythmic wood-on-hard-surface tapping sound occurs twice. A male voice speaks with a slightly authoritative, inquisitive tone over a light acoustic guitar background. (2) A young girl's voice responds concisely. (3) The male voice asks another question, tone rising slightly in pitch. (4) The girl's voice answers again, maintaining a neutral, soft tone. (5) The male voice asks a longer question about time duration, maintaining conversational speed. (6) The girl's voice pauses slightly then answers '9 years'. (7) The male voice becomes more confrontational and louder, questioning the lack of success. (8) A new adult female voice enters with a calm but sharp, teasing tone, delivering a punchline. (9) The male voice makes a short, high-pitched surprised sound 'Huh?'. The BGM stops abruptly, followed by silence.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To create a humorous social media skit where a father's attempt to critique his children's YouTube success is met with a sharp comeback about his own Instagram following.
